title: 基于深度强化学习的Transformer方法求解开放车间调度问题
summary: 提出一种基于Transformer编码器-解码器架构的调度策略，仅以加工时间矩阵为输入，在Taillard小规模基准上训练后可直接泛化至40x40至100x100的大规模实例，平均makespan与下界差距为12.89%-15.12%，优于SPT和LPT，与EST相当。
summary_en: A Transformer-based scheduling policy for the open shop scheduling problem, trained on small Taillard instances, generalizes to large instances (40x40 to 100x100) with makespan gaps of 12.89-15.12% vs. lower bound, outperforming SPT and LPT while remaining competitive with EST.
